title: News
subtitle: Keep yourself informed about the most recent additions and improvements we’ve made to InayaBridge.

v1_0_0.title: InayaBridge Launch — Version 1.0.0
v1_0_0.intro: We are proud to announce the first public release of InayaBridge: a free and secure teleconsultation platform designed to make online healthcare accessible to everyone.

features.label: Unlimited video consultations
features.desc: With our integrated video system, doctors and patients can connect freely without limits.

features.label: Patient and record management
features.desc: A structured medical history that is secure, accessible, and editable.

features.label: Secure messaging
features.desc: An internal chat for asking questions, sharing documents, or ensuring follow-up.

features.label: Patient statistics and reports
features.desc: Analyze your consultations and track your activity (available to all doctors from V1).

features.label: Record exports (PDF)
features.desc: Generate and download consultation summaries and prescriptions in one click.

v1_0_0.conclusion: These features are included for all users in the Essential plan (free), as well as in the Plus and Pro plans coming in version 2.
